review_candidates.title: Manager, Network & Systems Engineering
review_candidates.description: About IMG Academy IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field. IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on-campus and online experiences: Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state-of-the-art campus in Bradenton, Florida Online coaching through IMG Academy+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences Position Summary IMG Academy’s Campus Technology Department is seeking a technically deep and operationally driven Manager of Network & Systems Engineering to lead a high-performing team of network and systems engineers supporting one of the world’s premier sports and education campuses. This is a practitioner-leader role and will need to be comfortable configuring a core switch or troubleshooting a complex systems issue as well as running a team standup or presenting to senior leadership. This role is the technical backbone of campus connectivity and computing infrastructure, overseeing enterprise networking, server systems, identity management, cloud and hybrid environments, and the overall health and reliability of the platforms that power campus operations. We are looking for someone that can be hands-on across network engineering and systems administration, with a proven track record of leading technical teams and delivering infrastructure initiatives at scale. This individual is expected to remain technically active and current, contributing directly to engineering work alongside team members, not just directing from the sidelines. IMG Academy operates as a highly integrated campus environment, and this role reflects that reality: This role will have opportunities crossing discipline lines when the campus needs it, whether that means jumping into an AV issue, pulling structured cabling, or supporting physical infrastructure alongside other Campus Technology teams. They will drive the design, deployment, and ongoing evolution of campus network and systems infrastructure, ensuring security, scalability, and operational excellence across a complex, always-on environment that directly supports student-athletes, faculty, staff, and events. Position Responsibilities Team & Operational Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network and systems engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics across network operations, systems uptime, and infrastructure reliability. Manage staffing schedules, workload prioritization, and on-call rotations to ensure 24/7 operational readiness for campus-critical systems. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching and development plans, and identify training opportunities aligned to team and departmental goals. Network Engineering Oversee the design, deployment, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of campus-wide wired and wireless network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, switching, routing, and wireless systems. Ensure network reliability, redundancy, and security across all campus environments, including dormitories, academic facilities, athletic venues, and administrative buildings. Lead the planning and execution of network refresh and upgrade cycles, including hardware lifecycle management and capacity planning. Maintain and enforce advanced knowledge standards across the team covering Layer 1 through Layer 7 networking, including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, QoS, SD-WAN, and wireless controllers. Partner with the Director of Campus Technology on network security strategy, including firewall policy, access controls, network segmentation, and intrusion detection/prevention systems. Drive adoption of SD-WAN, cloud networking, and network automation where appropriate to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead. Maintain accurate and up-to-date network documentation, diagrams, and configuration records. Systems Engineering Direct systems engineers in the administration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of server infrastructure, including physical and virtual environments (VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent). Oversee identity and access management systems, including Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Okta, and MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune preferred). Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans are in place, regularly tested, and maintained for all critical systems. Drive adoption of cloud and hybrid infrastructure strategies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, in alignment with departmental roadmaps and campus needs. Maintain and enforce standards for OS patching, endpoint management, and system compliance across all campus-managed devices. Oversee storage infrastructure, including SAN/NAS environments and backup systems, ensuring capacity and performance meet campus demands. Security & Compliance Serve as the operational lead for network and systems security, working in partnership with campus leadership to maintain a strong security posture. Ensure consistent application of security policies, access controls, and compliance requirements across network and systems infrastructure. Lead incident response for network and systems-related security events, coordinating investigation, containment, and remediation. Conduct regular reviews of vulnerability reports, patch compliance, and access logs; drive remediation efforts within established timelines. Project & Vendor Management Lead and contribute to the planning and execution of capital and operational technology projects, from scope definition and budgeting through implementation and closeout. Develop cost estimates and scopes of work for network and systems upgrades; present findings and recommendations to departmental leadership. Manage vendor relationships, procurement, and contract activities for network hardware, software licensing, and systems infrastructure. Track and manage project budgets, purchase orders, and financial controls in adherence to campus fiscal policies. Identify and implement process improvements that increase the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of network and systems operations. Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration Provide regular, timely updates to the Director of Campus Technology and campus leadership on project status, system health, incidents, and departmental metrics. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Athletics, Academics, Facilities, Finance, and Operations to ensure network and systems solutions align with campus program needs. Serve as the hands-on escalation point for major network outages and systems incidents, actively participating in diagnosis and resolution alongside the team, while ensuring clear, timely communication with impacted stakeholders. Translate complex technical concepts and findings into clear, executive-friendly communications and reporting. Provide cross-functional support across Campus Technology teams as campus needs dictate, including AV and physical infrastructure assistance, structured cabling, and other layer 1 work, reflecting the integrated, all-hands nature of a complex, always-on campus environment. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities 7+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems administration, or a related IT infrastructure discipline 3+ years of experience in a people management or team lead role, with demonstrated ability to lead and develop technical staff Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise networking: routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, VLANs, wireless, firewalls, and network security, with demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues at the network and systems layer Solid working knowledge of systems administration: Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS/DHCP, virtualization (VMware or Hyper-V), and endpoint management Experience with identity and access management platforms including Okta or equivalent SSO/IAM solutions Proven experience managing technology projects, including budgeting, scheduling, and vendor coordination Demonstrated ability to provide clear updates to senior leadership and executive audiences Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills across interconnected network and systems environments Excellent written and verbal communication skills Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and IT service management/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent) Experience in a large campus, higher education, sports, entertainment, or multi-facility environment Relevant industry certifications: CCNP, CCNA, CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified (Azure/M365 Administrator), or equivalent Experience with SD-WAN platforms, cloud networking, and hybrid infrastructure environments Familiarity with MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune preferred) and endpoint compliance frameworks Experience with network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, or equivalent) Proficiency with network documentation tools (Visio, NetBox, or equivalent) and ITSM platforms Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including IaaS, Azure AD/Entra ID, and hybrid connectivity Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent experience. Background Requirements Requires a background check upon offer Requires a drug test upon offer Benefits As a full-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part-time and seasonal/temporary roles. Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options 401k with an Employer Match Short Term and Long Term Disability Group and Supplemental Life & AD&D Gym Discount Program Pet Insurance Wellbeing Program and more! Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Get To Know Us Better www.imgacademy.com www.imgacademy.com/careers IMG Academy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Install, configure, maintain, and support laptops, desktops, workstations, docking stations, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and associated peripherals. Manage and support end-user devices utilizing Microsoft Intune, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Endpoint Management policies. Provision, manage, and troubleshoot Windows Autopilot deployments, device enrollments, compliance policies, conditional access requirements, and software deployment packages. Support and administer Microsoft technology platforms including Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint Online, and related cloud services. Administer and support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), user account management, group policies, access controls, and identity management solutions. Support and maintain VMware environments, backup systems, firewalls, network infrastructure, and server platforms as required. Monitor server, endpoint, and network infrastructure to proactively identify, troubleshoot, and escalate potential issues before they impact business operations. Coordinate with internal IT teams, external vendors, and service providers to resolve complex technical issues and fulfill business technology requirements. Administer, support, and troubleshoot business-critical applications, ensuring optimal performance, availability, and user satisfaction. Manage and support GoAnywhere Managed File Transfer (MFT) solutions, including user provisioning, access management, transfer monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with business stakeholders. Provide support for secure file transfer processes and ensure compliance with organizational security and data handling standards. Support audio and video recording platforms used for legal proceedings, meetings, training sessions, and business operations. Manage the storage, organization, retrieval, transfer, and archival of audio and video recording files in accordance with company policies and retention requirements. Support multimedia playback, transcription, recording, and conversion software, ensuring users can access and utilize recorded content effectively. Troubleshoot issues related to media file formats, codecs, recording systems, streaming technologies, and supported media player applications. Maintain and support conference room technologies, audiovisual (AV) equipment, Microsoft Teams Rooms, video conferencing systems, and presentation technologies. Provide hands-on support for secure environments, restricted-access systems, and locations where remote support is not permitted. Perform onboarding activities for new employees, including device provisioning, software installation, account setup, access requests, and workplace technology readiness. Manage offboarding activities including asset recovery, access removal, license reclamation, inventory reconciliation, and compliance with security requirements. Maintain accurate IT asset inventory records, lifecycle management data, asset tagging information, warranty tracking, and audit-ready documentation. Create, maintain, and continuously improve technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge base articles, and user guides. Assist with hardware and software procurement activities, inventory planning, vendor coordination, and technology refresh programs. Work closely with networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application support, and global IT teams to deliver integrated technology solutions. Participate in office technology deployments, site expansions, relocations, infrastructure upgrades, hardware refresh programs, and IT project initiatives. Ensure compliance with corporate IT policies, security standards, software licensing requirements, and regulatory obligations. Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, automate routine administration tasks, and enhance the overall end-user technology experience. Participate in disaster recovery planning, business continuity testing, and operational readiness activities for supported technologies and applications. Provide after-hours, on-call, or emergency support as required to maintain business continuity and critical service availability. Required Qualifications Qualification, certification, or current study toward a qualification in a relevant ICT field (preferably at university level). Required Experience Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in Information Technology, Deskside Support, End User Computing (EUC), Service Desk, or Workplace Technology support roles within a medium to large enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience supporting 1,000+ end users in a corporate environment, with the ability to manage high volumes of incidents, service requests, and day-to-day operational support activities. Proven experience delivering end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding services, including provisioning hardware, software, accounts, and access for an average of 15–20 new hires per day while maintaining service quality and compliance requirements. Strong hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Microsoft 365, Autopilot, VPN solutions, FTP/MFT platforms (including Go Anywhere preferred), and IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow and Jira. Experience managing Windows endpoint deployments, device lifecycle management, software distribution, compliance policies, mobile device management (MDM), and endpoint security controls. Proven ability to partner effectively with business managers, department leaders, HR teams, and executive stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver technology solutions that support operational needs. Experience providing both remote and onsite support for hardware, software, network connectivity, collaboration tools, and business-critical applications. Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Windows 10/11 environments, Microsoft 365 applications, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Active Directory, and enterprise collaboration platforms. Experience managing IT assets, inventory tracking, asset lifecycle processes, hardware procurement, warranty management, and audit compliance activities. Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple tasks, manage competing deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. Experience working within SLA-driven support organizations, including incident management, problem management, escalation handling, and root cause analysis. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and customer service skills with a focus on delivering an exceptional end-user experience. Experience supporting conference room technology, audiovisual systems, video conferencing platforms, and multimedia solutions is highly desirable. Exposure to VMware, networking fundamentals, file transfer solutions, backup technologies, and enterprise security practices is preferred. Previous experience supporting legal, professional services, healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated environments will be considered advantageous Preferred Skills & Experience Strong experience in Microsoft enterprise environments. Knowledge of IP networking concepts including DHCP, DNS, and general networking principles. Experience supporting Audio-Visual (AV) technologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities. Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Strong attention to quality and detail. Ability to work collaboratively as a team player with a proactive, “can-do” attitude. Willingness to learn and continuously develop technical expertise. review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Real Time Systems
review_candidates.description: PLEASE NOTE THIS ADVERT CLOSES THE DAY BEFORE ANY AUTOMATED DATE SHOWN – PLEASE REFER TO THE CLOSING DATE IN THE ADVERT Senior Systems Engineer - Real Time Systems Location - Glasgow SPHQ or Edinburgh Park Salary + benefits - From £55,000 to £68,750, plus comprehensive benefits package Help us create a better future, quicker Join SP Energy Networks as a Senior Systems Engineer within our Advanced Energy Management Systems (AEMS) team, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Scotland's electrical grid. The AEMS team drives the strategic development of Smart Grid applications and systems that enhance electrical network capabilities through sophisticated control systems. As we evolve towards Distribution System Operator (DSO) and Transmission System Operator (TSO) Smart Grid Applications, you'll define technical solutions and standards for transformative projects including Wide Area Monitoring Systems (WAMS), REPOWER, and overarching Orchestration systems. This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of renewable energy integration and help deliver Scotland's Net Zero goals by 2044. What you'll be doing As a Senior Systems Engineer, you'll serve as the technical authority for one or more AEMS projects, defining technical standards and validating solutions deployed by our delivery team. You'll produce comprehensive solution designs that balance technical excellence with operational requirements. Your role involves working closely across the wider business, partnering with teams including Network Planning & Regulation, SPT, SPD, and SPM to ensure solutions meet both technical and operational needs. You'll engage with our Cybersecurity team to maintain compliance with security architecture standards, and work alongside the Smart Grid Operations team covering Telecoms, Infrastructure, and Real Time Systems to deliver fully operational designs that meet organizational standards. We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. Job Summary The Government Relations (GR) Manager is responsible for overseeing all interactions with government authorities and ensuring full compliance with Saudi regulatory requirements. This role manages governmental processes related to licensing, visas, work permits, and other operational approvals essential for the company’s continuity. The GR Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the company and government bodies, ensuring timely and efficient execution of all regulatory obligations. Additionally, the role will coordinate with Tetra Pak–appointed legal partners in Jordan, Lebanon, Yemen, Kuwait, and the UAE on matters involving government regulations and compliance. This position will be based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. What You Will Do Government Liaison & Compliance Build and maintain strong relationships with key government entities, including MOHR, GOSI, MISA, Civil Defense, Customs, Chamber of Commerce, MOI, and Municipality. Ensure full compliance with all Saudi labor laws, immigration regulations, and governmental procedures. Manage business licenses, renewals, permits, and legal documentation to ensure seamless and uninterrupted operations. Employee Visa & Work Permit Management Supervise the issuance, renewal, and cancellation of visas, work permits, and residency (Iqama) for all employees. Support new staff and their direct family members so they settle smoothly. Oversee the creation and renewal of employment contracts within the Qiwa platform. Manage the Saudization program, ensuring adherence to mandated quotas and national workforce regulations. Regulatory Strategy & Reporting Monitor updates to Saudi laws, regulations, and policies, CR’s, all kind of licenses, providing timely insights on their impact to senior management. Ensure accurate and timely submission of required reports, filings, survey’s and documentation to relevant authorities. Develop and implement process improvements to optimize government-related workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Manage one person directly reporting to you, admin assistant/broker. Crisis Management & Dispute Resolution Address government-related disputes and compliance issues in collaboration with HR and Legal teams. Act as the primary point of contact during audits, inspections, and official reviews conducted by government authorities. Lead the disciplinary committee activities and participate in staff disciplinary processes We believe you have Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Public Relations, Law, or a related field. Minimum of 6 years’ experience in Government Relations within logistics, e-commerce, or multinational organizations. Technical & Regulatory Expertise Strong knowledge of Saudi labor regulations, immigration rules, and general business compliance requirements. Hands-on experience with GOSI, Muqeem, Qiwa, and Mudad systems. Interpersonal & Professional Skills Established network and strong relationships with key government entities and regulatory bodies. Excellent communication skills in both Arabic and English, with strong negotiation and stakeholder management abilities. Proven problem-solving capabilities with the ability to manage complex regulatory processes and resolve compliance challenges effectively. Travel to Riyadh and other countries - GCC when needed We Offer You A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements Apply Now If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

review_candidates.title: Assistant Construction Manager - Transmission & Distribution (Northeast Region)
review_candidates.description: Description The Assistant Construction Manager will assist the Construction Project Manager, Project Manager, Site Manager, and/or the Engineer Procure Construct (EPC) Project Manager or Program Manager with day to day management of project safety, quality, schedule, cost control, contracts, subcontractors, suppliers, procurement, proposals, estimates, documentation, turnover, client interface, field-based activities, and other duties required to execute Engineer Procure Construct (EPC) projects, construction management, and program management ventures. This position will work on a diverse array of projects across the electrical substation, transmission & distribution and power generation industries. Adhere to company's safety programs, training, and policies as well as collaborate with the project team to manage the Safety & Health performance of project team members, contractors, and others as required. Collaborate with the Project Management team to build client relationships while interfacing with the client for proposal and project related items. Assist in the development of internal and external project risk reviews with the Project Management team and consult with the Legal Department as required. Coordinate and assist in the development and implementation of the Project Execution Plan, Quality Assurance Plan, Safety & Health Plan, Subcontracting Plan, Project Staffing Plan, Organization Chart, and Procurement Plan. Contribute to the negotiation, approval and execution of multiple types of prime contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and change orders. Develop the project plan for site mobilization and demobilization and support the Construction Manager or Site Manager with implementation. Secure applicable project permits required for the project. Support development of and coordinate the potential bidders' registration and pre-qualification efforts on behalf of the Project team. Prepare Request for Proposal (RFP), support detailed scope of work development, bid and selection process, creation of contract documents for the purpose of subcontractor and client contractor selection and award. Support the implementation of multiple project specifications, drawing releases, and design changes. Execute downstream contract administration, including Request for Information (RFI's), submittals, meeting minutes, change management, and claims mitigation. Support project cost reporting, scheduling, work breakdown structures, project set-up and closeout, and field progress tracking processes. Prepare information for and report project status, risks, schedule, costs, and cash flows at project and corporate level meetings to internal and external stakeholders. Develop and distribute meeting minutes as needed. Support the Prime Contract, subcontract, client contractor, and supplier invoicing process. Establish, review and implement the project documentation and filing systems and processes. Verify the project, client contractor, and/or subcontractor's insurance, licensures, taxes/duties, and securities are in effect according to the project requirements. Support and conduct project safety, quality, progress and financial audits and assessments as required. Facilitate the materials receiving and management process including inventory control, receiving of goods, storage, and transportation. Collaborate with Superintendents and Site Managers to verify compliance of subcontractor's client contractors contract documents, safety & health requirements, quality, and schedule. Facilitate the project turnover documentation, recordkeeping/retention, warranty and project close out processes. Assist with maintaining compliance on all project related activities by consistently applying company policies and procedures. Assist with the development of project labor agreements with building trades as required. Assist with onboarding of craft/field supervision as required. Analyze composite crew rates to determine labor and equipment costs. Work with field operations/craft HR team to appropriately staff projects. Analyze and monitor labor burdens including craft classifications, benefits and labor laws. Maintain accurate craft classifications and craft progression records. Assist with upholding standards of craft competency and training. Estimate, forecast and manage craft install unit rates, production rates to ensure earned value, schedule, change management and ensure cost metrics are met. Assist with applicable craft training. Manage construction equipment to ensure adequate inventory to complete projects. Performs other duties as assigned. Complies with all policies and standards. Qualifications Bachelor Degree in Construction, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field and 3 years relevant construction experience is required. Applicable experience may be substituted for the degree requirement. Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Access). Experience with document control, scheduling, cost control and project management software is preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong organizational skills. Strong analytical and problem solving skills, and attention to detail. Ability to handle large volumes of work and multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Multiple years of experience on construction project sites or executing program management in the industries of aviation, commercial, energy, government, manufacturing, oil & gas, process, transmission & distribution, transportation, or water is preferred. A basic understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. Must be able to meet the company's driving requirements. Compensation $120,000.00-175,000.00 Yearly The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year-end incentive bonus program. Benefits Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits & Wellness page. This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled. Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com Job Description Role: Senior Project Manager Location: Macau,SAR Role Overview As a Senior Project Manager in Project Management, you will be responsible for leading the execution of construction and workplace projects, ensuring quality, cost, safety, and scheduling objectives are met. You will coordinate stakeholders, manage site operations, and foster a collaborative and high-performing project environment. Key Responsibilities Planning & Execution:Mall specified A&A projects as assigned by Client Management team Develop, plan and implement projects. Ensure that all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. Master programme Establish (with Client Management Team direction), maintain and update the master programme via Microsoft (“MS”) Project (provided by Buyer) for all key A&A and Tenancy projects (list of projects to be provided Coordination: Assigned specified A&A projects: Lead the delivery of Food & Beverage (“F&B”) projects, including coordination of specialized fit-outs, equipment installation, and operational handover. Manage specified A&A projects include shop subdivisions and combinations, Buyer operated shop design and fit-out, base build mechanical, electrical and plumbing (“MEP”) modifications to suit incoming retailer needs (such as additional plumbing and drainage or power upgrades), duplex creation, front of house mall modifications and any other retailer related small projects. Monitor and oversee the full tendering process, including collaboration with Buyer’s consultants for preparation of tender documents, evaluation of bids, and contractor selection. Provide strong construction management oversight, ensuring quality control, progress monitoring, and adherence to timelines throughout the construction phase including defects rectification. Collaborate internally with Buyer’s Mall Management team and other stakeholders such as Procurement, Legal and Facilities Management in order to determine the project requirements and timelines. Collaborate externally with Buyer’s appointed consultants and contractors to manage the design and deliver the project in a compliant manner within budget. Manage contractors and consultants to obtain necessary permits and licenses with the appropriate Macau authorities. Assist Client determining, applying and managing the project budget. Maintain comprehensive project plan, programme, documentation and reports (as required) for the projects under your management; Coordinate the timely handover of projects to Buyer’s Mall Management (or stakeholder as assigned). Oversee and liaise with contractors, ensuring that work is carried out as per specifications and with minimal disruption to mall operations. Master Programme: Collaborate internally with Client Management Team and other stakeholders such as DPM and Facilities Management in order to report project status against the master programme; Report status against master programme to Client Management Team on a weekly basis using system Compliance & Safety Ensure that all works comply with both the local building codes and safety regulations and Buyer’s safety standards Monitor and manage any risks associated with your specific projects Qualifications Degree in Construction, Project Management, Engineering, Building science or a related discipline. Minimum 10 years’ experience in managing A&A, retail/F&B/mall projects in Macau Strong knowledge of project management concepts, tools, and techniques. Proven experience leading small to medium-sized construction projects of low to medium complexity. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and meet tight deadlines. Strong communication and leadership skills; fluency in English required. Good knowledge of MS Office suite. Proficiency in MS Project. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community. Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects: Twitter Instagram LinkedIn It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. review_candidates.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, High-Precision Assembly
review_candidates.location: Gia Tan 1 Commune, Dong Nai, Vietnam
review_candidates.description: Job Description Coherent Vietnam is seeking Manufacturing Engineers to support the transfer, ramp-up, and ongoing production of high-precision optical, mechanical, and opto-mechanical assemblies used in advanced semiconductor equipment. This role is focused on precision assembly in a Class 1000 cleanroom environment. The products are complex, high-value subassemblies where dimensional accuracy, optical performance, cleanliness, FOD/ESD control, process discipline, and documentation accuracy are critical. The selected candidates will work closely with global engineering, manufacturing, quality, metrology, and production teams to establish robust local manufacturing capability in Vietnam. The role includes hands-on process support, technician training, troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and close collaboration with the United States development and manufacturing teams. The selected candidates will have the opportunity to spend significant upfront training time in the United States. We are open to considering candidates at Engineer, Senior Engineer, or Team Lead level depending on relevant experience, technical expertise, and leadership capability. Manufacturing Environment This is not a traditional high-volume production role. The manufacturing environment is low-volume, high-value, and technically demanding, with strict customer, quality, and documentation requirements. You Will Work With High-precision optical, mechanical, and opto-mechanical assemblies used in advanced semiconductor equipment Class 1000 cleanroom manufacturing environments Sensitive optical, coated, precision-machined, and high-value components Strict FOD, ESD, contamination-control, and cleanliness requirements Precision assembly tooling, calibrated fixtures, torque tools, adhesives, and alignment methods Advanced inspection and metrology systems including CMM, optical inspection, interferometry, and precision mechanical measurement equipment Manufacturing processes with strong emphasis on quality, traceability, process stability, yield, and on-time delivery Working Location: Nhon Trach 1 (Dong Nai) Key Responsibilities Support the transfer and ramp-up of high-precision semiconductor equipment assembly processes from the United States to Vietnam. Develop, review, maintain, and improve manufacturing processes for complex optical, mechanical, and opto-mechanical assemblies to ensure process stability, product quality, yield performance, operational efficiency, and on-time delivery. Create and update work instructions, assembly procedures, process-control sheets, travelers, kitting documents, inspection records, and technician training materials, ensuring alignment with quality and traceability requirements. Train, support, and qualify technicians and production teams on assembly methods, cleanroom behavior, optical-component handling, tooling, inspection steps, documentation discipline, and quality requirements. Work hands-on in a Class 1000 cleanroom manufacturing environment with precision components, calibrated tools, fixtures, adhesives, and inspection equipment. Support setup, qualification, use, and improvement of assembly tooling, fixtures, process equipment, inspection methods, and process controls. Ensure compliance with FOD, ESD, cleanliness, contamination-control, product-handling, optical-component handling, cleanroom requirements. Troubleshoot assembly, alignment, inspection, cleanroom, and process issues; identify root causes; and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. Support first-article builds, pilot builds, process validation, production qualification, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities. Work with CMM, precision mechanical measurement tools, optical inspection tools, and interferometric metrology systems as required. Analyze process data, inspection results, metrology data, and quality trends to improve yield, process stability, cycle time, and overall manufacturing performance. Support process capability improvement, process-control activities, and data-driven problem solving to strengthen manufacturing performance and process stability. Work closely with engineering, production, quality, maintenance, supply chain, metrology, and global technical teams to support operational objectives, customer requirements, and manufacturing readiness. Support customer audits, internal audits, ISO activities, and quality-system requirements as required. Promote a disciplined, safe, clean, and continuous-improvement-oriented manufacturing environment. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field. Preferred majors include Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Precision Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Optics or Optical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or Applied Physics. 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, assembly engineering, process engineering, production engineering, or related technical roles within high-precision manufacturing environments. Experience in one or more of the following industries is highly preferred: Semiconductor equipment manufacturing, Optical or photonics manufacturing, High-precision mechanical or opto-mechanical assembly, Precision machining and tooling, Cleanroom manufacturing, Medical device manufacturing, Aerospace manufacturing, Automotive precision manufacturing, High-reliability industrial manufacturing Experience working with precision assembly tools, calibrated tools, fixtures, torque tools, adhesives, and precision measurement equipment. Familiarity with calipers, micrometers, depth gauges, height gauges, dial indicators, and similar precision inspection tools. Experience with CMM inspection, precision metrology, optical measurement, interferometry, or other high-accuracy inspection methods is strongly preferred. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances, assembly procedures, process-control documentation, inspection records, and metrology reports. Understanding of FOD control, ESD control, contamination prevention, 5S, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement methodologies is advantageous. Strong hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to work directly on the manufacturing floor. High attention to detail and commitment to process discipline and quality. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify process gaps, tooling limitations, quality risks, and training needs. Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with technicians, engineers, quality teams, production leaders, metrology teams, and international stakeholders. Good English communication skills are required. Willingness and ability to travel to the United States for technical training and technology transfer activities. Strong ownership mindset, patience, discipline, and commitment to operational excellence. Preferred Candidate Profile Direct semiconductor equipment experience is not required. We welcome candidates from related high-precision industries, including: Semiconductor equipment manufacturing Optical assembly and photonics manufacturing High-precision mechanical or opto-mechanical assembly Cleanroom manufacturing Precision machining and machine-build environments Medical devices Aerospace manufacturing Automotive precision manufacturing Metrology and high-accuracy inspection systems Low-volume, high-value manufacturing environments with strict process and documentation control Why Join Us? This is a high-growth opportunity to help build advanced high-precision optical and mechanical assembly capability for semiconductor equipment in Vietnam. You will gain exposure to international engineering teams, advanced cleanroom manufacturing practices, semiconductor-industry quality expectations, precision metrology, optical inspection methods, and hands-on technical training in the United States. As Vietnam becomes a strategic growth location for advanced manufacturing, this role offers strong career-development potential in a specialized and growing field. The successful candidates will contribute directly to building a new local capability for Coherent Vietnam and supporting global semiconductor equipment supply chains. Culture Commitment Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.: I ntegrity – Create an Environment of Trust C ollaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas A ccountability – Own the Process and the Outcome R espect – Recognize the Value in Everyone E nthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work Coherent Corp. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. About Us Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us! Note to recruiters and employment agencies: We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals for enterprises across diverse industries in Korea such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, energy and telecommunications. Cohere seeks an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across Customer Success, Sales Development, Marketing and Sales Engineering. You’ll be the voice of the field and partner with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. In this highly self-directed role, you are someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you’ll help us reach it. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) new_matches.description: About IMG Academy IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field. IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on-campus and online experiences: Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state-of-the-art campus in Bradenton, Florida Online coaching through IMG Academy+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences Position Summary IMG Academy’s Campus Technology Department is seeking a technically deep and operationally driven Manager of Network & Systems Engineering to lead a high-performing team of network and systems engineers supporting one of the world’s premier sports and education campuses. This is a practitioner-leader role and will need to be comfortable configuring a core switch or troubleshooting a complex systems issue as well as running a team standup or presenting to senior leadership. This role is the technical backbone of campus connectivity and computing infrastructure, overseeing enterprise networking, server systems, identity management, cloud and hybrid environments, and the overall health and reliability of the platforms that power campus operations. We are looking for someone that can be hands-on across network engineering and systems administration, with a proven track record of leading technical teams and delivering infrastructure initiatives at scale. This individual is expected to remain technically active and current, contributing directly to engineering work alongside team members, not just directing from the sidelines. IMG Academy operates as a highly integrated campus environment, and this role reflects that reality: This role will have opportunities crossing discipline lines when the campus needs it, whether that means jumping into an AV issue, pulling structured cabling, or supporting physical infrastructure alongside other Campus Technology teams. They will drive the design, deployment, and ongoing evolution of campus network and systems infrastructure, ensuring security, scalability, and operational excellence across a complex, always-on environment that directly supports student-athletes, faculty, staff, and events. Position Responsibilities Team & Operational Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network and systems engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics across network operations, systems uptime, and infrastructure reliability. Manage staffing schedules, workload prioritization, and on-call rotations to ensure 24/7 operational readiness for campus-critical systems. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching and development plans, and identify training opportunities aligned to team and departmental goals. Network Engineering Oversee the design, deployment, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of campus-wide wired and wireless network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, switching, routing, and wireless systems. Ensure network reliability, redundancy, and security across all campus environments, including dormitories, academic facilities, athletic venues, and administrative buildings. Lead the planning and execution of network refresh and upgrade cycles, including hardware lifecycle management and capacity planning. Maintain and enforce advanced knowledge standards across the team covering Layer 1 through Layer 7 networking, including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, QoS, SD-WAN, and wireless controllers. Partner with the Director of Campus Technology on network security strategy, including firewall policy, access controls, network segmentation, and intrusion detection/prevention systems. Drive adoption of SD-WAN, cloud networking, and network automation where appropriate to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead. Maintain accurate and up-to-date network documentation, diagrams, and configuration records. Systems Engineering Direct systems engineers in the administration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of server infrastructure, including physical and virtual environments (VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent). Oversee identity and access management systems, including Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Okta, and MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune preferred). Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans are in place, regularly tested, and maintained for all critical systems. Drive adoption of cloud and hybrid infrastructure strategies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, in alignment with departmental roadmaps and campus needs. Maintain and enforce standards for OS patching, endpoint management, and system compliance across all campus-managed devices. Oversee storage infrastructure, including SAN/NAS environments and backup systems, ensuring capacity and performance meet campus demands. Security & Compliance Serve as the operational lead for network and systems security, working in partnership with campus leadership to maintain a strong security posture. Ensure consistent application of security policies, access controls, and compliance requirements across network and systems infrastructure. Lead incident response for network and systems-related security events, coordinating investigation, containment, and remediation. Conduct regular reviews of vulnerability reports, patch compliance, and access logs; drive remediation efforts within established timelines. Project & Vendor Management Lead and contribute to the planning and execution of capital and operational technology projects, from scope definition and budgeting through implementation and closeout. Develop cost estimates and scopes of work for network and systems upgrades; present findings and recommendations to departmental leadership. Manage vendor relationships, procurement, and contract activities for network hardware, software licensing, and systems infrastructure. Track and manage project budgets, purchase orders, and financial controls in adherence to campus fiscal policies. Identify and implement process improvements that increase the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of network and systems operations. Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration Provide regular, timely updates to the Director of Campus Technology and campus leadership on project status, system health, incidents, and departmental metrics. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Athletics, Academics, Facilities, Finance, and Operations to ensure network and systems solutions align with campus program needs. Serve as the hands-on escalation point for major network outages and systems incidents, actively participating in diagnosis and resolution alongside the team, while ensuring clear, timely communication with impacted stakeholders. Translate complex technical concepts and findings into clear, executive-friendly communications and reporting. Provide cross-functional support across Campus Technology teams as campus needs dictate, including AV and physical infrastructure assistance, structured cabling, and other layer 1 work, reflecting the integrated, all-hands nature of a complex, always-on campus environment. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities 7+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems administration, or a related IT infrastructure discipline 3+ years of experience in a people management or team lead role, with demonstrated ability to lead and develop technical staff Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise networking: routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, VLANs, wireless, firewalls, and network security, with demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues at the network and systems layer Solid working knowledge of systems administration: Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS/DHCP, virtualization (VMware or Hyper-V), and endpoint management Experience with identity and access management platforms including Okta or equivalent SSO/IAM solutions Proven experience managing technology projects, including budgeting, scheduling, and vendor coordination Demonstrated ability to provide clear updates to senior leadership and executive audiences Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills across interconnected network and systems environments Excellent written and verbal communication skills Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and IT service management/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent) Experience in a large campus, higher education, sports, entertainment, or multi-facility environment Relevant industry certifications: CCNP, CCNA, CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified (Azure/M365 Administrator), or equivalent Experience with SD-WAN platforms, cloud networking, and hybrid infrastructure environments Familiarity with MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune preferred) and endpoint compliance frameworks Experience with network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, or equivalent) Proficiency with network documentation tools (Visio, NetBox, or equivalent) and ITSM platforms Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including IaaS, Azure AD/Entra ID, and hybrid connectivity Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent experience. Background Requirements Requires a background check upon offer Requires a drug test upon offer Benefits As a full-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part-time and seasonal/temporary roles. Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options 401k with an Employer Match Short Term and Long Term Disability Group and Supplemental Life & AD&D Gym Discount Program Pet Insurance Wellbeing Program and more! Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. new_matches.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Real Time Systems
new_matches.description: PLEASE NOTE THIS ADVERT CLOSES THE DAY BEFORE ANY AUTOMATED DATE SHOWN – PLEASE REFER TO THE CLOSING DATE IN THE ADVERT Senior Systems Engineer - Real Time Systems Location - Glasgow SPHQ or Edinburgh Park Salary + benefits - From £55,000 to £68,750, plus comprehensive benefits package Help us create a better future, quicker Join SP Energy Networks as a Senior Systems Engineer within our Advanced Energy Management Systems (AEMS) team, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Scotland's electrical grid. The AEMS team drives the strategic development of Smart Grid applications and systems that enhance electrical network capabilities through sophisticated control systems. As we evolve towards Distribution System Operator (DSO) and Transmission System Operator (TSO) Smart Grid Applications, you'll define technical solutions and standards for transformative projects including Wide Area Monitoring Systems (WAMS), REPOWER, and overarching Orchestration systems. This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of renewable energy integration and help deliver Scotland's Net Zero goals by 2044. What you'll be doing As a Senior Systems Engineer, you'll serve as the technical authority for one or more AEMS projects, defining technical standards and validating solutions deployed by our delivery team. You'll produce comprehensive solution designs that balance technical excellence with operational requirements. Your role involves working closely across the wider business, partnering with teams including Network Planning & Regulation, SPT, SPD, and SPM to ensure solutions meet both technical and operational needs. You'll engage with our Cybersecurity team to maintain compliance with security architecture standards, and work alongside the Smart Grid Operations team covering Telecoms, Infrastructure, and Real Time Systems to deliver fully operational designs that meet organizational standards. You'll assist with systems design activities, ensuring compliance with Group standards while defining streamlined processes for efficient project delivery. Your expertise will inform business case development, outlining costs, benefits, and delivery approaches for system development or refresh initiatives. Throughout project delivery, you'll provide technical assistance to ensure successful completion with clear stakeholder communication. Building and maintaining relationships with suppliers is key, as you'll oversee service delivery to ensure on-time, on-budget performance. You'll contribute expert technical input to architectural planning, ensuring plans and budgets reflect the investment required to achieve our desired state. Your role includes evaluating and recommending new system solutions and technologies, planning for emerging customer needs and new infrastructure from an electrical applications perspective. What you'll bring You'll have a degree in electrical, electronic, or telecommunication engineering, or relevant equivalent experience. Alternatively, an HND/HNC qualification with at least five years of post-training experience in an engineering or project management role within a utility business is required. Your technical expertise includes in-depth experience with Smart Grid applications or real-time control system development. You'll bring working knowledge of Smart Grid Electrical Control Systems and ADMS (Advanced Distribution Management System) or SCADA technologies, or Power Systems Engineering. A proven track record of design and delivery that balances technical and commercial considerations is essential. You're numerically articulate with exceptional attention to detail, capable of devising solutions to complex technical problems. Your communication skills enable you to explain sophisticated technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, whether verbally or in writing. You excel at consulting with colleagues across the business, resolving differences, and presenting unified perspectives. You work effectively with external vendors, customers, and stakeholders. You're skilled at prioritizing work effectively and managing technical, financial, and project delivery risks. Experience gained through operational, technical, and commercial engineering roles is valuable. Project management skills are desirable, as is experience managing teams. You'll need to be comfortable reviewing and evaluating proposals from third parties, influencing stakeholders at business and technical levels, and working with colleagues across Iberdrola globally. A valid driving licence is essential, as the role requires travel to fulfill duties and obligations. What's in it for you As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%. Benefits At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action -- our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world -- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include: 36 days annual leave Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave Equity Plans Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments Life Assurance (4x salary) Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more Why SP Energy Networks SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world presence in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's goal to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly enabling the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a focus on investing in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation. Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. These values bring us into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all backgrounds and experiences to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support. If you need adjustments, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com. Mobility Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements. IMPORTANT Advert will close at 23:59 GMT the day before Job Posting End Date below September-28-2026

Position Overview: EngageWell seeks a dedicated and community-oriented Client Navigator to assist clients in accessing telemedicine and digital health programs across our network. This role provides direct, hands-on support to clients, focusing on digital literacy, health navigation, and engagement in care. The Client Navigator works under the supervision of the Program Director. Key Initiatives Supported: Healthy Aging: Mental health, cognitive, and heart health assessments and telemedicine visits for adults over 60. Medication adherence for adults over 60. Telemedicine Health Program: Urgent care and remote screenings for mental health, nutrition insecurity, and heart health with telemedicine visit and referrals. HIV Control Program: Medication adherence and engagement in care. Digital Food Pantry & Nutrition Program (Tangelo): Digital food pantry with home-delivered food boxes to improve food-related chronic conditions and food insecurity. Digital Literacy & Inclusion: Building client confidence in technology: o  Provide clients with personalized assistance using digital health apps (Tangelo, Perx Health) and telemedicine platforms. o  Deliver one-on-one and group digital literacy education, in-person and remotely. o  Support client connections to telemedicine appointments and to follow-up medical, behavioral health, and social services. o  Conduct outreach and re-engagement with clients not currently in care. o  Facilitate remote patient monitoring for blood pressure control and health data collection. o  Conduct home visits and field-based outreach as needed. o  Gather client feedback to inform program improvement. o  Participate in community events and health fairs. Administrative Responsibilities Document all client interactions and outcomes in data systems. Participate in program evaluation activities and team check-ins. Assist in data collection, reporting, and quality improvement efforts. Support distribution of client incentives (e.g., gift cards). Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred. At least 5 years of experience in case management, community health work, or peer navigation (or equivalent combination of training and experience). CHW or Peer Educator Certification a plus. Strong communication skills and ability to engage diverse populations. Comfort with smart phone and digital health applications. Knowledge of NYC’s healthcare and social service landscape. Preference given to bilingual applicants (Spanish/English). Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Haitian Kreyòl is a plus. Must be comfortable conducting home and field visits. Must be comfortable navigating the NYC public transportation system. Working Conditions Full-time position; hybrid of fieldwork/home visits (60%), and remote, work-from-home (40%). Must be available for occasional evenings/weekends for community events. Skills Detail oriented and comfortable working directly with sensitive data, cleaning data, and managing spreadsheets. Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Team player who can work closely with others with respect and a sense of humor. Ability to stay organized when working on multiple projects; willingness to ask for help when needed. Ability to work remotely and communicate effectively with colleagues regarding deliverables. Willingness to travel throughout the five boroughs of NYC, when needed. Familiarity with Unite Us for client referrals and tracking a plus. Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and Google tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Google Forms, etc.). Experience working in grant-funded social service programs. Knowledge and understanding of harm reduction principles and trauma-informed care. Level of Language Proficiency Preference given to bilingual applicants (Spanish/English). Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Haitian Kreyòl is a plus. Benefits EngageWell provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, age, disability, or genetics. EngageWell complies with all applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the organization operates. EngageWell also does not request prior salary information during the hiring process. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, and training. We offer a comprehensive healthcare and benefits package to full-time employees, including health, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement matching, short-term disability, and life insurance. Staff begins accruing PTO immediately for a total of up to 20 days earned in the first year. Federal student loan payments made during employment with EngageWell meet 'Federal Student Loan Forgiveness' requirements. EngageWell also offers partial utilities reimbursement (wi-fi/electricity) to support remote work. Full details of fringe benefits will be made upon an offer for employment. About EngageWell Community Health & Innovation Collaborative EngageWell CHIC is a start-up, nonprofit organization formed by 20 not-for-profit health and human services agencies in New York City, using a multi-year grant from New York State (NYS) to develop the infrastructure necessary to offer value-based, clinically integrated services to Medicaid Managed Care (MMC) enrollees. In the next few years, the small EngageWell leadership team will be responsible for 'standing up' a 21st Century healthcare organization dedicated to improving the quality of care for low-income New Yorkers with chronic medical conditions and serious behavioral health disorders. Today, the EngageWell network of community-based organizations promotes access to life saving services, increases engagement and retention in care, and advances the dignity and wellbeing of marginalized populations across NYC. Our member agencies have a long history of addressing the social determinants of health (SDH) for individuals with complex medical, behavioral, and long-term care needs that drive a high volume of high-cost healthcare interventions. Member agencies provide the following services to address the medical, health, and social determinants of health needs for clients: Care Management / Care Coordination Behavioral Health: Mental Health & Substance Use Counseling, Syringe Exchange, Opioid Treatment, Overdose Prevention Prevention Services: Food / Nutrition, Education, Wellness, Peer Support, HIV Prevention, Harm Reduction Other SDH: Housing, Pre-vocational Services, Supported Employment, Employment / Vocational Services, Legal Services Medical: Primary Care, Dental Care, Pharmacy, HIV Prevention/Treatment
